# Homebrew tap

Homebrew formulae for `sander-ed` projects.

<!-- Generated by the sander-ed/gnosis release workflow from
     packaging/homebrew/README.md. Do not edit this file by hand. -->

## Install Gnosis

Install [Gnosis](https://github.com/sander-ed/gnosis) on macOS or Linux with
[Homebrew](https://brew.sh):

```sh
brew tap sander-ed/tap https://github.com/sander-ed/sander-ed-tap.git
brew install gnosis
gnosis --help
```

The explicit tap URL is needed because this repository is named `sander-ed-tap`
rather than Homebrew's conventional `homebrew-tap`. The local tap name remains
`sander-ed/tap`.

The formula installs a prebuilt, checksum-verified binary from the
[Gnosis GitHub Releases](https://github.com/sander-ed/gnosis/releases), plus Git
for runtime use. No Rust toolchain is installed and no GitHub account, token,
or SSH key is required.

## Upgrade

```sh
brew update
brew upgrade gnosis
```

If you installed an earlier version that was built from source, Homebrew
also installed Rust and LLVM as build dependencies. After upgrading you can
remove them with `brew autoremove`, unless you use them for something else.

## Publish a new version

Bump `[package].version` in the Gnosis `Cargo.toml`, run `cargo update -p gnosis`,
and push to the source repository's `main` branch.

The source repository's **Release** GitHub Actions workflow checks each push. If
the version differs from the formula, it tests the release commit, builds
binaries for macOS, Linux, and Windows, publishes a `vVERSION` tag and GitHub
Release, and commits the regenerated formula and this README to this tap.
Unchanged versions are skipped.

The formula and this README are generated from `packaging/homebrew/` in
[`sander-ed/gnosis`](https://github.com/sander-ed/gnosis). Edit them there.

To retry a failed publication, run the workflow manually in
[`sander-ed/gnosis`](https://github.com/sander-ed/gnosis/actions/workflows/homebrew.yml).
Existing tags are reused, never moved.

The workflow authenticates with a dedicated write-enabled deploy key on this
tap, stored as the source repository's `HOMEBREW_TAP_DEPLOY_KEY` Actions secret.
If rotating it, replace both the deploy key here and that secret.

## Troubleshooting

If you installed the tap before it became public or was renamed, switch its
remote to the current HTTPS URL so updates do not need GitHub authentication
or rely on the old repository redirect:

```sh
git -C "$(brew --repository sander-ed/tap)" remote set-url origin \
  https://github.com/sander-ed/sander-ed-tap.git
```

If `gnosis` still runs an older Cargo installation, check `which gnosis`.
`~/.cargo/bin/gnosis` may precede Homebrew in your `PATH`. The Homebrew binary is
`$(brew --prefix)/bin/gnosis`; adjust your `PATH` if you want it to take precedence.
